answer: First, charge every new identity a 75-unit genesis tax that is never refunded. Then, lock it into a 3-epoch observation window: each honest epoch earns back 15 units in fees, while a proven fake burns the remaining tax and is frozen 8 epochs. Finally, price the attack: 1,000 clones pay 75,000 up front, and 30% caught burns 18,000. A prism splits one beam into many colors; this tax splits one budget into many sunk costs, so forgery cannot recycle capital. The kernel: the tax is paid once per identity and never returns, so an orchard of fakes costs a fortune to plant.
